tools.name: getCWV
tools.description: Get Core Web Vitals data for a URL

url.description: The URL to get Core Web Vitals data for

period.description: The collection period count in weeks, up to 40

origin.description: Whether to use origin or url for fetching data, either "origin" or "url"

device.description: The device form factor to filter by, either "all", "phone", or "desktop", default is "all"
